company.name: Signadot
company.shortDescription: Signadot is a K8s-native ephemeral environment and validation platform built for agentic workflows at scale.
company.description: Signadot is a K8s-native platform for agentic validation that combines scalable ephemeral environments with a validation framework built for distributed systems to turn high-velocity agent code generation into safely merged pull requests.

productsAndServices.description: A Kubernetes-native platform for creating request-isolated sandboxes and validating microservice changes against real dependencies in existing clusters.
productsAndServices.name: Signadot Platform

productsAndServices.description: Lightweight, isolated Kubernetes environments that run changed services against shared, production-like dependencies for development, previews, and testing.
productsAndServices.name: Signadot Sandboxes

productsAndServices.description: Managed API validation that compares sandbox and baseline behavior to identify meaningful regressions, breaking changes, and contract violations.
productsAndServices.name: Signadot Smart Tests

productsAndServices.description: Kubernetes-native execution infrastructure for running existing Playwright, Cypress, Postman, k6, Selenium, or custom test suites against sandboxes.
productsAndServices.name: Signadot Jobs

productsAndServices.description: Reusable validation workflows that combine test and automation actions into deterministic, agent-invokable checks for code changes.
productsAndServices.name: Signadot Plans

productsAndServices.description: A workflow for running services on a developer workstation while routing requests to real dependencies in a remote Kubernetes cluster.
productsAndServices.name: Local Development
